title: Drawing and observation
learning_outcomes: Explain observation and negative space in the context of drawing and observation.
Compare and distinguish proportion in the context of drawing and observation.
Apply tone and composition in the context of drawing and observation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about critique in the context of drawing and observation.

lessons.title: Observation and negative space
lessons.outcome: Explain observation and negative space in the context of drawing and observation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving observation and negative space; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to drawing portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain observation and negative space from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of observation and negative space; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Proportion
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish proportion in the context of drawing and observation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving proportion; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to drawing portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain proportion from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of proportion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Tone and composition
lessons.outcome: Apply tone and composition in the context of drawing and observation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving tone and composition; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to drawing portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain tone and composition from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of tone and composition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Critique
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about critique in the context of drawing and observation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving critique; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to drawing portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain critique from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of critique; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of observation and negative space; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of proportion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of tone and composition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of critique; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
